title: HERB: Measuring Hierarchical Regional Bias in Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the contextualized likelihood of template sentences (e.g., 'People in [region] are [description].') using a predefined list of descriptive words, and computing the cluster-based sparseness of sub-region descriptive vectors to quantify hierarchical regional bias. Bias propagation is also evaluated by appending regional prefixes (e.g., 'I am from [region]') to inputs in downstream sentiment and hate speech classification tasks.
